method: derive-face-documents.ts identity: population controls from subject-facts.json (facePopulationControls), sixteen frontal anthropometric indices solved one control each (faceAnthropometry, faceAnthropometrySolve) under each subject's portrait lens, on landmark-anchors-lens.json; two of them (lipParting, cornerLift) read a state and write expression, and the identity-only pass leaves them at zero

derive-face-documents.ts expression: detector scores over the identity's own rest reading through expression-calibration.json (faceExpressionTransfer), each unit calibrated with its partner on the other side (faceExpressionPartner)
derive-face-documents.ts identity again with that expression, then once more with each index's target corrected by what the product render of the previous documents showed through the same detector

hair, iris and material values from the source study: fit-face-hair-shape.ts (hair-shape.json), then fit-face-brows.ts, fit-face-iris.ts, fit-face-hair.ts and fit-face-lips.ts on the photographs (appearance-fit.txt)
